label: Architectural View
description: How architectural photographers approach built form — optics, camera position and the geometry discipline of the view. Indoor-only approaches carry the 'indoor' tag.

items.name: shifted-wide
items.text: a 24mm shift lens with the camera held dead level, verticals perfectly parallel, the rise dialed in to take the full height without tilting

items.name: one-point-axis
items.text: a strict one-point perspective straight down the central axis, every line converging on a single vanishing point, symmetry held to the millimeter

items.name: telephoto-stack
items.text: a long telephoto from a distant vantage, perspective compressed until the receding planes stack flat like sheets of cut paper

items.name: raking-detail
items.text: a tight detail study in raking light, the surface thrown into relief, joints and texture reading like topography

items.name: worms-eye
items.text: a worm's-eye view aimed straight up, converging lines deliberately embraced, the geometry wheeling overhead into near-abstraction

items.name: reflection-double
items.text: composed on a still reflection — flood water, wet paving, polished stone — the geometry doubled into perfect bilateral symmetry

items.name: frontal-elevation
items.text: a flat-on frontal elevation, the surface square and parallel to the sensor like an architect's drawing, no convergence anywhere in the frame

items.name: three-quarter-hero
items.text: the classic three-quarter view, two faces of the form carrying two different light values, volume modeled by the corner between them

items.name: doorway-frame
items.text: shot through a doorway aligned as a frame within the frame, room opening beyond room in nested thresholds of light

items.name: window-light-axis
items.text: composed across the fall of window light, the camera square to the wall, bright shafts striking diagonally through the standing space

items.name: stairwell-spiral
items.text: looking straight up the open eye of a stairwell, the handrail spiraling into a nautilus of repeating treads

items.name: ceiling-mandala
items.text: camera aimed at the ceiling from dead center of the room, vault ribs or coffer grid resolving into a mandala of structure

items.name: corner-two-point
items.text: a quiet two-point view into the corner of the space, both walls receding evenly, furniture and fittings kept exactly square
